responsibility: Contains the GIMPLE/tree-level OpenACC support specific to the GCN backend, especially expansion of GOACC reduction internal functions and gang/worker shared-memory handling. It builds lockless compare-and-swap reduction loops for 32/64-bit values, falls back to lock-based updates for larger types, manages LDS-backed private objects and worker broadcast records, and implements target hooks that rewrite reduction setup/init/fini/teardown and adjust gang-private declarations into the address spaces and synchronization model expected by GCN kernels.
